name: A competitor's public page
description: One person's versions, GROUPED BY GAME AND SEASON, newest season first: someone who entered two seasons of one game has two standings, not one. PUBLIC, AND RETURNS ONLY WHAT IS PUBLIC -- `active` and `superseded`. A candidate mid-trial is a version nobody else may know exists and a rejection is nobody else's business, so the owner's own view is this response merged with GET /v1/models and GET /v1/me/matches rather than this route returning more to some callers.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object( 'handle', u.handle, 'display_name', u.display_name, 'role', u.role, 'baseline', u.role = 'baseline', 'created_at', u.created_at, 'games', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(x.section ORDER BY x.game, x.season DESC) FROM ( SELECT g.slug AS game, se.number AS season, json_build_object( 'game', g.slug, 'game_name', g.name, 'season', se.number, 'season_state', season_state(se), 'versions', json_agg(json_build_object( 'model_id', m.id, 'version', m.version, 'class', m.weight_class, 'size_bytes', m.size_bytes, 'status', m.status, 'repo', m.repo, 'release_tag', m.release_tag, 'created_at', m.created_at, 'ratings', model_ratings(m.id, ($2)::float8)) ORDER BY m.version DESC)) AS section FROM models m JOIN games g ON g.id = m.game_id JOIN seasons se ON se.id = m.season_id WHERE m.owner_id = u.id AND m.status IN ('active', 'superseded') GROUP BY g.slug, g.name, se.id) x), '[]'::json) ) AS body FROM users u WHERE u.handle = ($1)::text
